summary: Approximately 825,615 km² and about 2.5 million people (2017), from Wikidata's Q1030 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Namibia", at revision 1376104546, opens: "Namibia, officially the Republic of Namibia, is a country in Southern Africa. It borders the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Zambia and Angola to the north, Botswana to the east, and South Africa to the south; in the northeast, approximating a quadripoint, Zimbabwe lies less than 200 metres (660 ft) away along the Zambezi river near Kazungula, Zambia. Namibia's capital and largest city is Windhoek." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 565 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1990 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Windhoek. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1990-03-21. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
